description: Source code for validating radio configuration parameters in a ZMQ radio context, including functions for validating clock sources, LO frequency, channel arguments, streams, sampling rate, and overall configuration validity.

classes.name: radio_config_zmq_config_validator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating the overall radio configuration.

methods.name: validate_clock_sources
methods.description: Validates that clock sources are set to default.

methods.name: validate_lo_freq
methods.description: Validates that the LO frequency is non-zero and supported.

methods.name: validate_channel_args
methods.description: Validates that channel arguments describe a valid TCP socket.

methods.name: validate_channel
methods.description: Validates individual channel parameters including frequency, gain, and args.

methods.name: validate_stream
methods.description: Validates a stream containing channels and arguments.

methods.name: validate_sampling_rate
methods.description: Validates that the sampling rate is normal and positive.

methods.name: validate_otw_format
methods.description: Validates that the OTW format is default.

methods.name: is_configuration_valid
methods.description: Validates the entire radio configuration object.
